text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
With an intense day behind them, Hiyori and
{0} return to the guildhouse to rest their exhausted bodies.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}とヒヨリは慌ただしい一日を過ごし、
すっかりくたくたになりギルドハウスで休んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I sure am beat.
Glad we can finally get some rest.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ～、
やっと落ち着けるー……
さすがに疲れちゃったねー

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: The day's pretty much almost over, too.
text_block_list.orig_text: もうすっかり夜だし……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
It's kinda bright in spite of that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？　
なんか明るいね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's going on?!
It's so bright, but I'm... getting so... sleepy...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ！？　
なにこれ……！
まぶしいのに、
どんどん、
眠たく……
なる……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
{0} gets his fortune slip during his
first shrine visit of the year, only for
the wind to blow it right out of his hands.
text_block_list.orig_text:
初詣へ出かけた{0}は、
神社で引いたおみくじを眺めていたら、風にさらわれてしまった。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh. There's something stuck to my kimono.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
着物になにか引っかかってる……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: A fortune slip? Did someone throw it away?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おみくじだ。
捨てちゃったのかな？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh geez. First time I've seen a slip with bad luck.
Can't even imagine who could have pulled this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うわぁ。
凶なんて初めて見た。
どんな人が引いたんだろ……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Let's see here... \"Your desires won't come to fruition.\"
\"No splendid encounters await you.\"
A-ahaha...
choice_data_list: Hey Hiyori. Did a fortune slip come flying this way?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっと、
『願望、
叶わず』。
『待ち人、
きません』……
あ、
あはは……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hey there!
I did just pick one up there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーっ！　
先輩だー！
おみくじなら
ちょうどひろったところだけど……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey! Happy New Year!
text_block_list.orig_text:
先輩！　
あけましておめでとう！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Guess what? I picked up a fortune slip with bad luck on it just there.
choice_data_list: Thanks. I was looking for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇねぇ、
今ここで
凶のおみくじひろったんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Wait, this is yours?!
Which means you just finished up your first shrine visit of the year...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これ、
先輩のおみくじだったの！？
じゃあこの凶、
初詣で引きたてほやほやなんだね……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Well then. Sorry, I shouldn't have looked at it without permission.
Don't worry, though! It'll be fine if you tie it up at the shrine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだったんだー……
ごめんなさい。
勝手に見ちゃって……
でもおみくじは
神社に結んでおけば
きっと大丈夫だよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Look! I got great luck!
And great luck means lots of great things to come!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見て見て、
あたしは大吉引いたんだー！
大吉は
持ってるといいことがあるんだって！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ♪ Cool, right?
And hey. I got to see you this early into the year.
It's already paying dividends!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへー♪
　いいでしょー！
それに
お正月から先輩に会えて、
さっそくご利益があったよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I went with my friends from school today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あたしもね、
さっきまで学校の友達と初詣に行ってたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
We all got dressed up nice and fancy, so it was super fun!
We also got sweets from the stalls there,
plus we took pictures and stuff.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなで晴れ着でお参り、
楽しかったなぁー！
出店のお菓子も食べたし、
みんなで写真も撮ったしー……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: And also...
text_block_list.orig_text: それにね……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey. I... actually have something I want to get off my chest.
Would you mind taking some time to hear me out?
I'd really appreciate it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねえ、
先輩。
……運が悪かったと思って、
ちょっとだけあたしの話、
聞いてほしいんだけど……
いい？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: You're as kind as always, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
聞いてくれるんだ……
優しいね、
先輩は。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Well, um. One of my friends from class has a person she likes, you see.
And she asked me to cheer her on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えっとね、
クラスで仲のいい友達が
今、
片思い中なの。
それで、
応援してほしい
って言われたんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Thing is, another friend in one of my clubs also likes that person.
And well... She also asked me to cheer her on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
部活の友達にも、
同じ人に片思いしてる子がいたんだ。
あたし、
その子からも
応援してほしい
って言われちゃったんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
The boy they both like was with us today, too.
It got real tense at times, and dealing with that was exhausting.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その子たちが好きな男子も、
今日は一緒だったんだけど、
時々空気がピリピリして、
なんとかするのですっごく疲れたよ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
But they're both my friends, you know?
So now I'm stuck deciding if I should cheer just one,
or tell the both of them that I won't get involved.
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人とも友達だから、
一人だけを応援するのか、
どっちも応援できないって言っちゃおうかって、
ずっと悩んでて。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
But the more I think about it, the more confused I get.
You know that fortune slip I pulled? It's so bad that
I wasn't even happy about that, if I'm being honest.
choice_data_list: Just cheer both of them on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうしたらあたし、
どうすればいいのか
分からなくなった。
先輩。
今日の初詣ね、
大吉引けても
全然うれしくなかったよ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Both of them?!
text_block_list.orig_text: どっちも！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Won't one of them just end up feeling hurt if I do that, though?
choice_data_list: It might end up being both of them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもそれだと、
どっちか一人が傷ついちゃうんじゃないかな……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
O-oh. That's true.
They could both get turned down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうだよね……
二人ともアタックして振られちゃうかもしれない……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
What should I do, then?
I really don't have it in me to just leave them be.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
それじゃあどうすればいいんだろ……
何もしないなんて、
あたしにはやっぱりできないよ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Tell me. Is there [i]anything[/i] I can do?
choice_data_list: Just be by their side when they need it most.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先輩……
あたしにできること、
ないのかな？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Be by their side? Really?
text_block_list.orig_text:
先輩、
それってどういうこと……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... You're right.
The fact that you're hearing me out right now is already a big help.
Thanks a lot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん……
あたしは先輩が話を聞いてくれるだけで、
すっごく助かってる。
ありがとね、
先輩。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I never thought about it that way before, but it makes sense.
You don't need to do anything super special.
Just staying by the people you want to support is enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そっか。
こうして隣にいてあげるだけでも、
応援したい人のためになれるんだ！　
助けてあげられる！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much!
Now I know how to approach this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと先輩！　
あたし、
分かった！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
If anything happens, I'll make sure to stay by their side!
I'll hear them out, just like you did for me today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしもその子たちに何かあった時は、
隣にいてあげたい！
今日先輩があたしにしてくれたみたいに、
話を聞いてあげたい！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Cheering people on and pushing them along is good,
but they're not the only ways to help out!
text_block_list.orig_text:
元気づけたり、
後押しするだけが
誰かを助けることじゃないよね！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Thanks so much. I feel a lot better now.Really!
You're gonna go tie that fortune slip up, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへっ、
ありがとね、
先輩！　
あたしはもう大丈夫！
先輩はこのおみくじ、
結びに行くんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
You better hurry, otherwise all the bad luck'll come your way!
Just kidding! But take care! See ya!
text_block_list.orig_text:
早く行かないと、
どんどん不幸になっちゃうよー？
なんちゃって！　
気を付けてね！　
ばいばーい！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh. I forgot to ask something else important.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そういえば、
聞けなかった。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey. What if I want to cheer myself on?
What should I do then?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ねぇ先輩。
あたしが
あたしを応援したい時は、
どうすればいいのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
I dunno why, but I start to get all nervous and fiddly
around you these days. It's such a... weird feeling.
I just don't understand it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……先輩。
最近ね、
先輩の近くにいると、
ドキドキしちゃうんだ。
これって、
なんなのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back.
Did you have a nice dream?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
お疲れ様。
いい夢は見られたかしら？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Good to see that Hiyori cheered up.
text_block_list.orig_text: ヒヨリは元気になったみたいでよかったわね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
She's still a child, all things considered.
She'll grow, develop and change,
even without anyone else's help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの子はまだ成長過程なの。
だから放っておいても、
もっと伸びていくし、
変わっていくわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
But you're probably the only one that can lead her in the direction
that she'll feel satisfied with. That's a pretty important role, you know.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その方向をあの子の望むように導いてあげられるのは、
あんたくらいなの。
これって結構重大な役目よ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
And also. You talked the talk,
so make sure you stick by her if she's ever feeling hurt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもね、
あんなこと言ったからには、
ヒヨリちゃんが傷ついた時は、
ちゃんと最後まで隣にいてあげなさい。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
That's something that you, and only you can do.
...Don't forget that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それだけは本当に、
あんたにしかできないことよ。
……
覚えてて。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Anyway. Catch you later.
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあまたね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...
Huh. When did I fall asleep?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅん……
あたし、
いつの間に寝ちゃってたんだろ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Oh. It wasn't just me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
騎士くんも寝てたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Mr. Knight.
Thanks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あのね、
騎士くん……
ありがとね。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
What for? Nothing!
Hee hee!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにがって？　
なんでもな～い！
ふふふっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Well. Truth is, you appeared in the dream I had.
You told me to stick by the people I want to cheer on.
Or I think you did, at least.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……実はね。
夢の中で騎士くんが出てきて、
応援したい人の隣にいてあげたらって、
言われた気がしたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text:
Hey.
Guess who's by your side right here, right now?
Ehehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ騎士くん。
あたしも今、
騎士くんの隣にいるよ……
えへへっ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Hiyori sat down next to {0},
refusing to leave his side for quite some time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言って、ヒヨリは{0}の隣に座り、
しばらく離れず寄りそうのだった。
